caption: The drawing is done in pencil on a beige or off-white paper and consists of four main views of a box-like mechanical object. In the upper left corner, there is a small, horizontal rectangular diagram divided into six segments. To the right of this, in the top right quadrant, is a rectangular top view of the main object, displaying a central straight line with two small rectangular shapes at each end, and four circles near the corners. The lower left quadrant shows a side view of the box, depicted as a rectangle with a slanted top and a protruding vertical rod; an additional, thinner rectangular extension is shown in dashed lines emerging from the slanted top with a supporting dashed line beneath it. Inside the side view of the box is an oval containing an "X" formed by two diagonal lines. In the bottom right quadrant, there is a front view of the box, showing a large oval with an "X" inside, a curved handle extending upward from the top, and an additional small hook or latch at the center above the oval. The drawing is technical and features fine, precise lines without shading or color other than the natural tone of the paper and pencil marks.
title: Foot Warmer
